name: Gokaldas exports -- cup and handle/rising channel

commitments.text: New capacity addition in Jharkhand and Karnataka (2,000-3,000 new machines by FY28)
commitments.specifics: Total capex INR100 cr for both units; INR70-75 cr to be spent in FY27; each facility to add INR175-200 cr revenue in steady state; operational ramp FY28 H2, full contribution FY29
commitments.dependency: Capex execution and customer orders for new facilities
commitments.single_point_of_failure: Capex overruns or delayed order pickup

commitments.text: Maintain/expand EBITDA margins despite wage inflation and logistics pressures
commitments.specifics: Q1 FY27: absorbed INR20 cr wage cost increase (Haryana 35%, salary net effect 14-15%); offsetting via automation, efficiency, product mix shift to low-cost regions
commitments.dependency: Continued automation success and tariff/incentive stability (RoSCTL at risk of 50% cut in India)
commitments.single_point_of_failure: RoSCTL elimination or geopolitical tariff shocks (Hormuz, U.S. inflation)

commitments.text: BTPL fabric subsidiary merger (Q3 FY27) and ramp to profitability
commitments.specifics: BTPL currently running 50-53 lakh m/month; Q1 FY27 EBITDA loss 7.5-8% due to chem+fuel cost; targeting Q3 EBITDA positive, Q4 PBT positive post-merger; capacity to grow 30% post-merger integr
commitments.dependency: Successful merger integration and continued chemical+fuel cost moderation
commitments.single_point_of_failure: Post-merger synergy delays or customer attrition

commitments.text: U.S. Section 301 tariff (India at parity with competing sources, advantage vs China/Vietnam) + UK FTA (parity with Bangladesh/Vietnam, advantage vs China)
commitments.specifics: U.S.: India 10% vs China/Vietnam 12.5%. UK: India now parity with Bangladesh/Vietnam. U.K. FTA expected to boost customer confidence; early inquiries positive
commitments.single_point_of_failure: U.S. tariff hikes or UK tariff renegotiation

chain: Apparel exports to U.S. / UK / Africa (Section 301 parity tariff + FTA support)
Order book visibility: Q1 +21% revenue, Q2-Q4 orders being booked with 'fairly good' projections
Volume growth: 3.4% formal volume (misleading due to product mix: Q1/Q2 high-value outerwear, Q3/Q4 simpler garments)
Africa AGOA renewal (extends to Dec, likely 2-year extension in Senate +bipartisan) enables $112-115 M FY27 revenue (vs $80M FY26, +40% path)
BTPL merger upside: 50-53 lakh m/month capacity, targeting mid-single-digit EBITDA post-merge
earnings_chain.bottleneck_link: AGOA tariff certainty beyond Dec 2026; wage/logistics cost offset; BTPL profitability post-merger
earnings_chain.operating_leverage: yes -- Q1 revenue +21%, EBITDA +17% shows margin expansion despite headwinds; further upside from capacity ramp (Bhopal Ph2, Karnataka, Ranchi existing ramping by Q4) + BTPL integration
evidenced_links: India business +16% YoY (Section 122 tariff benefit); Africa +45% YoY
BTPL pre-merge revenue INR170 cr/quarter, capacity 50 lakh m/m, fabric orders in place
Existing capacity (MP Phase 2, Karnataka, Ranchi) ramping to full utilization by Q4
assumed_links: AGOA extended (Senate passed, House/President likely); tariff risk for H2 manageable
RoSCTL (incentive) sustained or only 50% cut (vs full elimination risk)
BTPL integration adds mid-to-high single-digit EBITDA margin by merger close

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: 32.5x P/E on Q1 FY27 earnings implies market prices 15-20% revenue CAGR and/or multiple expansion; apparel sector multiple typically 20-25x for mid-teens growth; risk is AGOA/tariff cliff risk post-Dec 2026
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: Revenue growth 15-20% (management confident); Africa $112-115M (up from $80M FY26, +40%), India tariff support holds; EBITDA margin 12-14% (squeezed by wages/logistics)
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: Revenue +12-15% (capacity ramp contribution + BTPL full-year); EBITDA margin 14-15% as automation/cost offsets mature; BTPL merger accretion +2-3% margin if integrated successfully
market_expectation.gap_basis: 32.5x on ~15% FY27 revenue growth is a premium to historical apparel 20-25x for similar growth; justified only if AGOA extends, tariff benefits hold, and BTPL merger succeeds. Downside risk if AGOA expires Dec 2026 without extension.
market_expectation.data_caveat: Current P/E from Yahoo Finance Oct 2, 2026. Management guided 15-20% growth but explicitly said 'confident of beating 15%'; AGOA extension not yet formalized (Senate pass only); Africa capacity utilization still 80-85% (upside to $120M if execution tightens)

catalyst.event: Q2 FY27 concall (strong order book visibility, capacity ramp updates); AGOA extension announcement (expected Senate→House→President, likely Q4 2026); BTPL merger close (Q3 target, should show first full-quarter traction Q4)
